items.exampleEn: The actor is famous for his chiselled jaw.
items.exampleZh: 那位演員以輪廓分明的下巴出名。

items.exampleEn: She reads eclectically, from science to poetry.
items.exampleZh: 她閱讀的範圍兼收並蓄，從科學到詩都有。

items.exampleEn: This tiny phone keyboard is too fiddly for my thumbs.
items.exampleZh: 這個手機小鍵盤太小太難按，我的拇指用不來。

items.exampleEn: The team played slackly in the second half and lost.
items.exampleZh: 這支隊伍下半場打得很鬆散，結果輸了。

items.exampleEn: The waiter spoke stuffily, as if we did not belong there.
items.exampleZh: 那位服務生說話一副拘謹古板的樣子，好像我們不該來這裡。
items.glossZh: 古板拘謹地；悶不通風地

items.exampleEn: The weather website predicts rain unreliably in the mountains.
items.exampleZh: 那個天氣網站在山區預測下雨很不可靠。

items.exampleEn: Her comments on my essay were gentle and unscathing.
items.exampleZh: 她對我這篇文章的評語溫和，一點也不尖刻。（unscathing＝not scathing，別和 unscathed「毫髮無傷」混淆）

items.sentenceEn: These stone steps were chiselled by hand hundreds of years ago.
items.sentenceZh: 這些石階是好幾百年前用手一鑿一鑿刻出來的。

items.audioEn: The trains on this line run so unreliably that I always leave home an hour early.
items.audioZh: 這條線的火車班次非常不可靠，所以我總是提早一小時出門。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼提早一小時出門？
options: Because the speaker likes breakfast near work.
Because the trains are often late.

items.sentenceEn: The rope hung slackly between the two boats.
items.sentenceZh: 繩子鬆垮地垂在兩艘船之間。

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather's flat is eclectically decorated with things from his travels.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺的公寓用他旅行帶回來的各式東西佈置，風格兼收並蓄。

items.stemEn: The old printer works ____, so we never know if a page will come out.
items.stemZh: 那台舊印表機運作很不穩定，我們從來不知道紙到底會不會印出來。

items.stemEn: Sewing these tiny buttons onto the shirt is really ____.
items.stemZh: 把這些小鈕扣縫到襯衫上真的很費工。

items.passageEn: Leo's furniture shop is a quirky place, eclectically furnished with pieces from every period: a chiselled stone lion sits next to plastic chairs from around 1970. Repairing old pieces is fiddly work, especially the tiny drawer handles, but Leo enjoys it. His website, however, runs unreliably, and orders sometimes disappear. Last month, a well-known critic visited the shop. Leo expected a very critical review, but the article was surprisingly unscathing. It only noted that the back room was stuffily warm and that the curtains hung slackly over the windows. After the article came out, sales rose by almost a third.
items.passageZh: Leo 的家具店是個古靈精怪的地方，擺滿各個年代的東西，風格兼收並蓄：一座石雕獅子，就擺在 1970 年左右的塑膠椅旁邊。修理老東西是很費工的事，尤其是那些小小的抽屜把手，但 Leo 樂在其中。不過，他的網站運作很不穩定，訂單有時會不見。上個月，一位知名評論家來店裡參觀。Leo 原本以為會被狠狠批評，沒想到那篇文章出奇地溫和，只提到後面的房間悶熱不通風，窗簾鬆垮地掛在窗戶上。文章刊出後，銷售量增加了將近三分之一。

questions.questionZh: Leo 的網站有什麼問題？
options: 運作不穩定，有時訂單會不見

questions.questionZh: 那篇評論對這家店的評價如何？

items.promptZh: 這台舊電梯運作很不穩定，我們最好走樓梯。
referenceEn: This old lift works so unreliably that we'd better take the stairs.
The old elevator runs unreliably, so we should take the stairs.
rubricZh: 「運作很不穩定」用 unreliably 修飾動詞（例如 works unreliably、runs unreliably 等）
「最好」可寫，例如 we'd better、we should 等

items.promptZh: 組裝這個模型很費工，因為有很多細小的零件。
referenceEn: Putting this model together is fiddly because it has lots of tiny parts.
This model is fiddly to build, with many small pieces.
rubricZh: 「很費工」用 fiddly（例如 is fiddly、fiddly to build 等）
